title: Repair manual CA batch pre-ship validation gaps
objective: Ensure the bounded manual Solana CA batch rejects an invalid CA before constructing any Helius source, reports unknown CLI failures without making a false credential claim, and makes the default test command execute the complete test suite.
forbidden_actions: Do not add cron, scheduler, background loops, automatic token discovery, provider fallback, database/cache writes, queues, address-library writes, or non-Solana chains.
Do not print, store, commit, or record credentials, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not weaken the manual 1-to-10 CA limit or claim creator, Dev, address, holder-concentration, or full-analysis facts.
